statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON (green). Tail remains in the low band while event, rates and geopolitical Stress are extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. The 12:30 UTC U.S. data cluster, the cash open and the multi-stage FOMC sequence are the main conditional checkpoints.
headline: Tail remains low before U.S. data and the FOMC while Nasdaq-100 futures recover modestly
body: The latest verified Reuters update had Nasdaq-100 futures 0.44% higher, oil lower and the U.S. 10-year yield near 5%. Direct live NQ retracement structure is not independently verified, so extreme event and macro Stress does not by itself establish a persistent no-mean-reversion Tail path.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 clock-hours, Tail ranged from 17% to 23%. WATCH covered parts of the September 15 U.S. session; Tail returned to the low band from 20:00 UTC and remained low through 11:00 UTC on September 16.
outlookSummary: Conditional Tail rises to WATCH around the 12:30 UTC releases, cash open and the multi-stage FOMC sequence, peaking at 24%. A higher band requires observed persistent one-way structure, failed retracements or a credible delayed second leg.

forecast.analysis: Current evidence shows Nasdaq-100 futures modestly higher, oil lower and yields near 5%, but direct live NQ pullback structure is not independently verified. The 12:30 UTC data cluster makes this hour a conditional WATCH window.
drivers: Nasdaq-100 futures were 0.44% higher in the latest verified Reuters update

forecast.analysis: The first post-data hour leads into the 13:30 UTC cash open. WATCH remains conditional: repeated extension after failed pullbacks would raise concern, while meaningful retracements would argue against a pathological path.
Early cash trade overlaps the 14:00 UTC business-inventories release. Tail stays at WATCH's upper edge unless opening direction broadens into persistent, shallow-pullback continuation.
drivers: Breadth and megacap alignment remain conditional

forecast.analysis: By late morning, Tail can ease if the opening impulse retraces normally. WATCH persists while post-data directional efficiency and cross-asset alignment remain unresolved.
Midday WATCH sits at its floor with the FOMC still ahead. Two-way trade and deeper retracements would be stabilizing; renewed one-way efficiency would keep risk elevated.
Risk rises into the 17:45 UTC danger-window start. A pre-decision extension that holds near an extreme would be the condition for greater Tail concern.

forecast.analysis: The 18:00 UTC FOMC decision and 18:30 press conference create peak event stress. Tail remains WATCH unless repricing becomes persistently one-way with failed retracements.

news.title: Warsh's words may matter more than the anticipated Fed rate hike

forecast.analysis: The press-conference hour remains a multi-stage repricing window. A second directional leg after an initial retracement would be the key adverse checkpoint; orderly two-way discovery would cap Tail.

news.title: Warsh's words may matter more than the anticipated Fed rate hike

forecast.analysis: After the formal FOMC sequence, WATCH persists while rates and equities digest guidance. Tail would stay contained if price discovery becomes two-way instead of repeatedly extending near extremes.
Late U.S. trade remains vulnerable to a delayed policy second leg, but conditional Tail eases from the peak. Sustained session-extreme holding would prevent further normalization.
With the main event sequence past, conditional Tail returns to the low band if no unresolved one-way extension persists. Residual rates and geopolitical stress keep overall Stress elevated.
The evening transition is expected to be less event-dense. Tail remains low unless U.S. closing structure leaves a persistent directional imbalance for the overnight session.
Early Asia risk is primarily residual from the U.S. policy session. A calm handoff and ordinary retracements would keep Tail low despite still-high macro uncertainty.
Overnight Tail stays low if liquidity remains two-way. A renewed bond or oil shock would be a conditional amplifier rather than assumed price-path evidence.

The forecast assumes no new persistent one-way structure is established. Low Tail reflects the absence of a scheduled U.S. catalyst in this hour, while residual FOMC uncertainty still supports elevated Stress.
drivers: No scheduled major U.S. catalyst this hour

forecast.analysis: Pre-European trade remains conditionally low Tail. A sharp cross-asset re-alignment would matter only if accompanied by persistent NQ extension or failed retracements.
European morning participation can test the overnight range. Tail remains low unless range expansion becomes directionally efficient and resists meaningful retracement.
Conditional Tail remains low as European trade develops. Two-way price discovery would reinforce normalization; persistent extension would invalidate that assumption.
As U.S. participants begin returning, Tail edges up slightly from overnight lows. Rates and technology leadership are the main conditional confirmation checks.
Premarket liquidity increases, but no major U.S. release occurs in this hour. Tail remains low unless cross-asset signals align with a directional NQ path.
The U.S. morning approaches with next-day labor and housing data still ahead. Tail stays low because those future releases are not treated as observed price-path evidence.
drivers: Next-day labor and housing data remain ahead
No hypothetical event outcome is assumed

forecast.analysis: Event proximity begins to lift Stress again, while Tail remains low. Any pre-release trend matters only if it becomes persistent and is confirmed by rates, breadth and technology leadership.
The next U.S. data cluster is within a few hours. Tail remains low in the absence of observed mean-reversion failure, while event uncertainty pushes Stress higher.
drivers: Initial claims and housing data approach
Observed retracement quality remains the Tail gate

forecast.analysis: The forecast ends one hour before the next 12:30 UTC claims and housing releases. Tail remains low but near WATCH, with any escalation reserved for observed persistent pre- or post-release structure.
drivers: 12:30 UTC housing starts and permits next hour
